description: One button starts your project, a map explains how everything is connected (CSS, front end, back end, database), local checks, QR for your phone and deploy to your VPS
untrusted: In an untrusted folder Quorvox only reads files: the project map, checks and editor hints work. Starting services, deploy, phone access and installing dependencies are off, because they run the project's code.
welcome:
There is no runnable project in this folder.
A package.json with a dev or start script, an index.html page (served as a site) or a quorvox.json file will do.
[Rescan](command:quorvox.rescan)
cmd.showLogs: Quorvox: Show logs in the Output panel
cmd.map: Quorvox: Project map (how everything is connected)
cmd.rollback: Quorvox: Roll the server back to the previous version
cmd.releaseOk: Quorvox: It works, delete the old version's copy on the server
cfg.autoRestart: Restart the service and refresh the browser page when files change
cfg.editor.diagnostics: Underline problems the checks find: an API address the server does not have, an unknown class, a broken file link. Works on unsaved text too.
cfg.editor.completions: Autocomplete for classes from your CSS and API addresses from the server (and .env variables), Ctrl+click to go to definition and hover info.
cfg.showDashboardOnStart: Open the dashboard tab with logs when services start
cfg.fixLinksOnMove: Fix links automatically when you move or rename a file or folder in the Explorer (drag and drop, F2). Ctrl+Z undoes the move and the link fixes together.
cfg.language: Language of Quorvox messages, map and dashboard. Auto follows the VS Code display language (Russian → Russian, anything else → English). Side-panel titles and command names follow the VS Code display language and change after restarting VS Code.
